snippet.title: Below Lethe | Official Trailer #1 (English)
snippet.description:
All artwork and animation featured in this video and in Below Lethe were created entirely by hand, without the use of generative AI.

The first official trailer for Below Lethe, a story-driven psychological horror adventure inspired by mythology, developed by Meisomi.

Uncover the truth hidden within the memories of the dead, reconstruct what happened, build your case before three judges, and make the final judgment.

Wishlist Below Lethe on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5120800/Below_Lethe/?l=english
